cross-chain messaging gateway. Carries arbitrary `payload` bytes;         token transfer (BambooOFT) is just one app on top. The gateway never         touches tokens or funds.         Trust model: (1) attesters sign a DOMAIN-BOUND digest of msgId, (2) a         threshold N-of-M is required. Replay is prevented per msgId.  Hardening in this version (from the self-audit):   H-1 domain separation: the signed digest binds to this gateway + its EVM chain,       so a signature cannot be replayed on another gateway/chain.   H-3 recovery: delivery is wrapped in try/catch; a failed delivery is stored and       can be re-attempted via retry() instead of reverting forever or being lost.   H-4 liveness: removing attesters cannot drop the set below the threshold.   M-1 pause: owner (\u2192 consortium multisig) can pause in an emergency.   M-4 governance: 2-step ownership; owner is meant to be a multisig + timelock.   L-2 reentrancy: receiveMessage/retry are nonReentrant (plus checks-effects order).","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"src/BambooGateway.sol":"BambooGateway"},"evmVersion":"cancun","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":200},"remappings":[]},"sources":{"src/BambooGateway.sol":{"keccak256":"0x713ef2fd48a0b4c62ae3cb476c31c569a44bf14df7d0a9676c0392e03bbce277","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://3f39c7d98a6eab75570845fd8eaf3f518e8349d2eb720b781cc9fad77e62b6ff","dweb:/ipfs/QmW8HsZNoD7huUvX4sf6315tCyBXY2jsouZgxoHyPad6ay"]},"src/IBambooReceiver.sol":{"keccak256":"0xa0fc2eabc1fff8bda4948886ea3972fdb8f111959637b208869b497f7d10236e","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://6a3ee651863879b595c5cc2737ccddbef1965f39a19b9ff6e038e07abc2dac1b","dweb:/ipfs/QmNhrrwr5hi23bfpZ8esHXmSLSySGjTmxFTwyRVZomKghi"]}},"version":1}
